verification.status: merged; fresh physical DualSense and owner Makko acceptance remain pending
verification.implementationStatusChange: PR #63 moved from review to merged main. The merge and reviewed source trees are byte-identical.

implementation.controllerRepair: Playable training now uses the normal mapped jump press/hold/release path. Cross/A or a saved remap performs the full variable-height jump; R1/RB remains inspect and no longer triggers a tiny jump.
implementation.dialogueInput: Create/View advances playable crew dialogue without clearing movement or held jump. Menu, intro and keypad control ownership remains contextual.
implementation.trafficWarning: An illustrated flashing red WATCH OUT tag and independent reversible arrow begin three seconds before a foreground car reaches the view, point from the correct edge at the projected car height, track camera and zoom, and end when the artwork first appears.
implementation.preserved: Original car speed, scale, altitude, bob, probability, queued launch and collision are unchanged. Jump physics, movement, musical rules, controller settings, hack meter, walk, upper routes and boss remain unchanged.

verification.lockedRequirementsPreserved: Single-jump movement, 20-defeat mission, eight-second hijack, music/boss rules, original four playable characters, Makko compatibility and all earlier retained requirements remain represented by the exact source tree.

failedHistoricalAcceptance.status: failed controller playtest; superseded by PR #63 repair, which still awaits fresh physical acceptance

steps.name: Check intro visibility in real Chromium

verification.normalPostMergeDeployment: Owner imports exact merge c6dc0116d08a70ca2c97edddb9404bd87e62906a into a fresh Makko preview. This maintenance does not deploy or alter Makko.
verification.focusedPostDeployEvidence: In playable training and gameplay, hold Cross/A for the normal approximately 286px 60Hz jump, release early for the short jump, repeat with a saved remap, confirm R1/RB inspects rather than jumps, and use Create/View to advance dialogue without stopping movement. Smoke-test settings and every hack-meter state. Observe WATCH OUT for three seconds from both directions at multiple camera heights and zooms; pause/resume/reset and confirm the cue follows the projected flight and ends at artwork entry while original car motion/collision remain. Then walk the long route, rooftops and boss flow. Record imported SHA, PASS/FAIL and clips.

runtimeLimitations: Makko supplies /lib/MakkoEngine.min.js; it is not included in Git.
Artwork and audio referenced by remote URLs remain externally hosted.
This source snapshot is not a self-contained offline build.
